packageRules.description: PR titles, and the squash commits GitHub makes from them, follow gitmoji-conventional: `⬆️ build(deps): update ...`. A rule for every package, because config:recommended's own rules set `chore` and `fix`; Renovate lowercases what follows the prefix. Nothing here produces a pin or a rollback, so neither gets its own emoji. See EXECUTION-LOG D-084.

Node major bumps are a judgement this repo makes against the release schedule, not by recency. The value is major-only, so every update is a major, and an automerged one can move the builder off Active LTS onto a Current-phase major -- shortening its support window with no human in the loop. See RFC 0009 decision 9 and EXECUTION-LOG A-41.

customManagers.description: Update annotated versions in docker-bake.hcl and the Dockerfile ARG defaults that copy them, in one pull request, so .github/scripts/arg-defaults.sh stays green (S-0002/D-1). Annotation order is datasource, depName, then the optional versioning and extractVersion, in that order.
